goal.user_contract: Implement solve(data) for {"ops": list of operations}. Each operation is an object with "kind" and, depending on kind, "amount" and/or "id". Apply the operations in order and return {"balance": int, "held": int, "available": int} where available is balance minus held. Rules, checked in exactly this order for each operation: (1) "kind" must be one of credit, debit, hold, release; anything else raises ValueError. (2) For credit, debit and hold, "amount" must be an integer of at least 1; otherwise ValueError. Booleans are not integers here and raise ValueError. (3) For hold, "id" must not already name an active hold; for release, "id" must name an active hold; a violation raises ValueError. (4) For debit and hold, "amount" must not exceed the currently available funds; otherwise ValueError. credit increases balance. debit decreases balance. hold adds an active hold of amount under id. release removes the hold named by id and ignores any "amount" field. The first failing operation raises and no result is returned. An empty operation list returns zeros. Do not mutate the input.
